ob.title: Welcome to MoveBit
ob.intro:
I live quietly in your tray, watching how long you actually work —
then, when the time comes, I'll kindly get you out of the chair.
ob.steps: Three quick steps and we're acquainted.
ob.strictQ: After how much continuous work should I interrupt you?
ob.modeGentleDesc: Toast every 60 minutes, never locks the screen
ob.modeStandardDesc: Lock all screens every 45 minutes for a 5-minute break
ob.modeStrictDesc: Lock all screens every 30 minutes for a 5-minute break
ob.strictFootnote: The "skip" button appears after 20 seconds; being away 5+ minutes resets the timer.
ob.waterTitle: How often should I nudge you to drink?
ob.soundHint: Forced breaks are always silent; only toasts chime
ob.pactOutro: Now, back to work. I'm watching.
ob.summaryForced: {0} min of continuous work → lock all screens for a {1}-minute break
ob.summaryToast: Toast nudge to stand up every {0} minutes
ob.summaryAway: Away from the desk over {0} minutes resets the timer
ob.settledBody: I'll wait quietly in the tray. See you at the next break.

breakHintPool: I'll watch the screen — you go drink that water

Stand up and roll your neck — I'll be right here waiting

Go get some water — say hi to my relatives
Think about that bug standing up. Maybe it cracks first

Your hips are on break for five minutes. The work isn't going anywhere
sitToastPool: The chair won't miss you, but your back will — Droplet

Stand up and let your blood rediscover your legs

Eyes off the screen — find the farthest thing you can see

Palms over your eyes for ten seconds. Let them breathe

Walk to the end of the hall. See who else is slacking

However deep the night, don't leave the glass empty
lateNightMicroPool: It's late. Twenty seconds on your feet — I'll whisper
